page.overview:
Who is Acklay?

The Acklay is a Star Wars creature. It first appeared as a model in a 2002 magazine and as a boss in a 2011 video game before debuting as a physical brick-built figure in 2016.

It is close to the appearance of a large praying mantis.

The Acklay appears in LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars and LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga levels based on the Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones film. The Acklay is a ferocious monster that fought in the Geonosian arena. It was eventually killed by Obi-Wan Kenobi using a lightsaber.
